contents.text: How much did Oracle pay in dividends to its stockholders in fiscal 2026?

Oracle paid $63 million in dividends to its Mandatory Convertible Preferred Stock holders and $5.7 billion in dividends to its common stock holders in fiscal 2026. (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations)
